subject.title: [Bug]: Web UI chat images display too large

question: Should maintainers adopt, replace, or reject the open fork PR that applies sidebar markdown image sizing parity for this issue?
rationale: The source-visible mismatch remains on current main and the latest release, but the available fix is an external fork PR with maintainer edits disabled, so cleanup automation should not close the issue or queue a competing fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt or replace the CSS parity fix
options.body: Create or land a maintainer-controlled version of the sidebar image sizing change with browser proof, then close the issue.

options.title: Wait for the fork author
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask the fork PR author for fresh proof and an updated branch.

options.title: Reject the parity path
options.body: Keep the issue open only if maintainers believe the oversized-image symptom needs a different proven root-cause fix.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the CSS parity fix
recommendation.body: Create or land a maintainer-controlled version of the sidebar image sizing change with browser proof, then close the issue.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev introduced the relevant sizing rules and is the clearest current history owner for this UI styling decision.
